title: Your account

scheme.systemHint: Light or dark as your device is set.
scheme.failed: The colour scheme could not be saved. It applies until you reload.

language.autoHint: English or German as your browser is set. Mails are in English.
language.failed: The language could not be saved. It applies until you reload.

saved: Saved. The panel looks like this in every browser you log in with.

email.title: Email
email.intro: For invitations, security notes about your account and the notifications you choose. Hostashi uses it only after you open the link it sends there.
email.openLink: Open the link in the email we sent there.
email.openLinkBefore: Open the link in the email we sent there before it expires <time/>.
email.sent: We sent a link to the new address. Check the inbox, and the spam folder if it does not arrive.
email.notSetUp: Email is not set up on this panel.
email.notSetUpHint: An administrator can set up an SMTP relay under Administration, Email.

errors.mail_not_configured: An administrator has to set up email first.
errors.no_public_url: The panel has no public address for links. An administrator has to set one.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts in the last hour. Try again later.
errors.link_invalid: The link is invalid, used or expired. Enter the address again on your account page to get a new one.
errors.mail_failed: The confirmation email could not be queued. Try again later.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.intro: Emails about problems on the server and your sites. Security notes about your account are always sent.
notifications.noMail: Notifications need email, which is not set up on this panel yet.
notifications.noAddress: Add and confirm an email address above to get notifications.

backups.label: Backups
backups.hint: A backup failed or did not save everything.

certificates.label: Certificates
certificates.hint: A renewal failed, or a certificate expires in 14 or 3 days.

doctor.label: Server checks
doctor.hint: Once a day, when the checks on the Health page find errors.

services.label: Services
services.hint: A service is down or keeps crashing, and again when it runs.

deploys.label: Git deploys
deploys.hint: A Git deploy of a site failed. Off until you switch it on.

php.label: PHP versions
php.hint: Once a week, when a site uses a PHP version near or past its end of life.

disk.label: Disk space
disk.hint: A disk or a site's quota is more than 90 percent full.

errors.second_factor_required: Your account must keep a second factor. Add a passkey or keep the authenticator app.
errors.too_many_passkeys: You have the most passkeys an account can have. Remove one first.

password.title: Password
password.newHint: At least 12 characters. Your other sessions are logged out.
password.mismatch: The new passwords do not match.
password.changed: Password changed. Your other sessions were logged out.

totp.title: Authenticator app (TOTP)
totp.on: On. Logging in with your password asks for a code from the app.
totp.off: Off. Logging in with your password asks for nothing else.
totp.turnedOff: The authenticator app is off. Its recovery codes no longer work.
totp.moved: The authenticator app was moved to the new device.
totp.moveIntro: Your old app keeps working until the new one shows its first code here.
totp.moveDone: The new app is in use. Codes from the old app and the old recovery codes no longer work. Keep these new recovery codes somewhere safe; each one works once.
totp.verifyMove: To move to a new phone or app, enter your password and a current code from the old app. If the old phone is gone, use a recovery code.
totp.verifyOff: To turn it off, enter your password and a current code from the app or a recovery code.
totp.code: Code from the app or a recovery code

passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.intro: A passkey logs you in without a password, with your device's lock or a security key. It counts as a second factor.
passkeys.name: Name of the new passkey
passkeys.nameHint: So you know it again, for example the device.
